highlights.text:
exports a set of efficient functions corresponding to
the intrinsic operators of Python

The variants
without the double underscores are preferred for clarity.

Note that these functions can return any value, which may
or may not be interpretable as a Boolean value.
The operator.isCallable() function was removed in Python 3.0.
